```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
# Load minimal data
data_list <- load_minimal_data(include_survival = TRUE)
dat_combined <- data_list$dat_combined
ctdna_long <- data_list$ctdna_long
survival_data <- data_list$survival_data
```

```{r define_universe, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Universe: Patients with radiation to metastasis (target in that row mentions metastasis)
# AND ctDNA available within 12 weeks before and 12 weeks after radiation
# ==============================

# Find radiation date and target columns
radiation_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("radiation.*date|radiotherapy.*date|rt.*date|sbrt.*date|stereotactic.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
radiation_target_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("radiation.*(target|site|location)|rt.*(target|site|location)|radiotherapy.*(target|site|location)", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Build radiation records with dates and targets matched at row level
# Strategy: Match columns by extracting numbers/indices from column names
# (e.g., radiation_1_date with radiation_1_target)
radiation_records <- tibble()

if (length(radiation_date_cols) > 0 && length(radiation_target_cols) > 0) {
  # Extract index numbers from column names for matching
  # Try to match date and target columns by their index numbers
  for (date_col in radiation_date_cols) {
    # Extract index from date column name (e.g., "radiation_1_date" -> "1")
    date_idx <- str_extract(date_col, "\\d+")
    
    # Find matching target column by index
    matching_target_cols <- NULL
    if (!is.na(date_idx)) {
      # Look for target columns with same index
      matching_target_cols <- radiation_target_cols[str_detect(radiation_target_cols, paste0("_", date_idx, "_|_", date_idx, "$|^", date_idx, "_"))]
    }
    
    # If no match by index, try matching by position
    if (length(matching_target_cols) == 0) {
      date_pos <- which(radiation_date_cols == date_col)
      if (date_pos <= length(radiation_target_cols)) {
        matching_target_cols <- radiation_target_cols[date_pos]
      }
    }
    
    # Process each matching target column
    for (target_col in matching_target_cols) {
      temp_records <- dat_combined %>%
        mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
        select(patient_id, all_of(c(date_col, target_col))) %>%
        rename(radiation_date_raw = all_of(date_col), rad_target_raw = all_of(target_col)) %>%
        mutate(
          radiation_date = as_date_safe(radiation_date_raw),
          rad_target_lower = tolower(as.character(rad_target_raw)),
          is_metastasis_target = str_detect(rad_target_lower, "metast")
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(radiation_date), !is.na(rad_target_lower), rad_target_lower != "")
      
      radiation_records <- bind_rows(radiation_records, temp_records)
    }
  }
  
  # Remove duplicates (same patient, same date, same target)
  radiation_records <- radiation_records %>%
    distinct(patient_id, radiation_date, rad_target_lower, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Filter for radiation records where target mentions metastasis
universe_raw <- radiation_records %>%
  filter(is_metastasis_target == TRUE) %>%
  select(patient_id, radiation_date, rad_target_lower) %>%
  distinct(patient_id, radiation_date, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Radiation records with metastasis target (matched): n =", nrow(universe_raw), "\n")

# Fallback: If no matched records, try finding patients with any radiation date AND any target mentioning metastasis
if (nrow(universe_raw) == 0) {
  cat("WARNING: No radiation records found with matched date-target pairs mentioning metastasis.\n")
  cat("Trying fallback: patients with any radiation date AND any target mentioning metastasis...\n")
  
  # Get all radiation dates
  all_rad_dates <- dat_combined %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
    select(patient_id, all_of(radiation_date_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "rad_var", values_to = "radiation_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(radiation_date = as_date_safe(radiation_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(radiation_date)) %>%
    select(patient_id, radiation_date) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # Get all targets mentioning metastasis
  all_met_targets <- dat_combined %>%
    mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
    select(patient_id, all_of(radiation_target_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "rad_target_var", values_to = "rad_target_raw") %>%
    filter(!is.na(rad_target_raw), as.character(rad_target_raw) != "") %>%
    mutate(rad_target_lower = tolower(as.character(rad_target_raw))) %>%
    filter(str_detect(rad_target_lower, "metast")) %>%
    select(patient_id) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # Combine: patients with both radiation date and metastasis target (not necessarily matched)
  if (nrow(all_rad_dates) > 0 && nrow(all_met_targets) > 0) {
    universe_raw <- all_rad_dates %>%
      inner_join(all_met_targets, by = "patient_id") %>%
      # For each patient, use their earliest radiation date
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(radiation_date = min(radiation_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(rad_target_lower = "metastasis (from separate columns)")
    
    cat("Fallback: Found n =", nrow(universe_raw), "patients with radiation dates AND metastasis targets (not matched)\n")
  } else {
    cat("Total radiation records found: n =", nrow(radiation_records), "\n")
    if (nrow(radiation_records) > 0) {
      cat("Sample targets:", paste(head(unique(radiation_records$rad_target_lower[!is.na(radiation_records$rad_target_lower)]), 10), collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }
}

# ctDNA inclusion criteria: 12 weeks before AND 12 weeks after radiation
WEEKS_BEFORE <- 12
WEEKS_AFTER <- 12
DAYS_BEFORE <- WEEKS_BEFORE * 7
DAYS_AFTER <- WEEKS_AFTER * 7

# Check for ctDNA before radiation (within 12 weeks)
ctdna_before <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(universe_raw, by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(
    ctdna_date >= radiation_date - days(DAYS_BEFORE),
    ctdna_date < radiation_date
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, radiation_date) %>%
  summarise(has_ctdna_before = n() > 0, .groups = "drop")

# Check for ctDNA after radiation (within 12 weeks)
ctdna_after <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(universe_raw, by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(
    ctdna_date > radiation_date,
    ctdna_date <= radiation_date + days(DAYS_AFTER)
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, radiation_date) %>%
  summarise(has_ctdna_after = n() > 0, .groups = "drop")

cat("Patients with ctDNA within 12 weeks before: n =", nrow(ctdna_before %>% filter(has_ctdna_before)), "\n")
cat("Patients with ctDNA within 12 weeks after: n =", nrow(ctdna_after %>% filter(has_ctdna_after)), "\n")

# Final universe: patients with radiation to metastasis AND ctDNA within 12 weeks before AND after
universe <- universe_raw %>%
  left_join(ctdna_before, by = c("patient_id", "radiation_date")) %>%
  left_join(ctdna_after, by = c("patient_id", "radiation_date")) %>%
  filter(has_ctdna_before == TRUE, has_ctdna_after == TRUE) %>%
  select(patient_id, radiation_date, rad_target_lower)

cat("Final universe size (with ctDNA within 12 weeks before AND after): n =", nrow(universe), "\n")
if (nrow(universe) > 0) {
  cat("Population studied: Patients with radiation to metastasis (target mentions metastasis) AND ctDNA available within 12 weeks before and 12 weeks after radiation\n")
} else {
  cat("WARNING: No patients meet inclusion criteria.\n")
}
```

```{r identify_conversion, include=FALSE}
# Identify ctDNA values before and after radiation (within 12 weeks)
WEEKS_BEFORE <- 12
WEEKS_AFTER <- 12
DAYS_BEFORE <- WEEKS_BEFORE * 7
DAYS_AFTER <- WEEKS_AFTER * 7

# Get ctDNA before radiation (within 12 weeks, closest to radiation)
ctdna_pre_radiation <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(universe, by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(
    ctdna_date >= radiation_date - days(DAYS_BEFORE),
    ctdna_date < radiation_date
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, desc(ctdna_date)) %>%  # Closest to radiation date
  group_by(patient_id, radiation_date) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, radiation_date, pre_radiation_ctdna_date = ctdna_date, pre_radiation_ctdna_value = ctdna_value)

# Get ctDNA after radiation (within 12 weeks, closest to radiation)
ctdna_post_radiation <- ctdna_long %>%
  inner_join(universe, by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(
    ctdna_date > radiation_date,
    ctdna_date <= radiation_date + days(DAYS_AFTER)
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%  # Closest to radiation date
  group_by(patient_id, radiation_date) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, radiation_date, post_radiation_ctdna_date = ctdna_date, post_radiation_ctdna_value = ctdna_value)

# Combine pre and post radiation ctDNA
conversion_data <- universe %>%
  left_join(ctdna_pre_radiation, by = c("patient_id", "radiation_date")) %>%
  left_join(ctdna_post_radiation, by = c("patient_id", "radiation_date")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Conversion: detectable (>0) before to undetectable (0) after
    converted = ifelse(!is.na(pre_radiation_ctdna_value) & !is.na(post_radiation_ctdna_value) & 
                       pre_radiation_ctdna_value > 0 & post_radiation_ctdna_value == 0, 1, 0),
    # Also track any change
    ctdna_change = ifelse(!is.na(pre_radiation_ctdna_value) & !is.na(post_radiation_ctdna_value),
                         post_radiation_ctdna_value - pre_radiation_ctdna_value, NA),
    ctdna_percent_change = ifelse(!is.na(pre_radiation_ctdna_value) & !is.na(post_radiation_ctdna_value) & pre_radiation_ctdna_value > 0,
                                100 * (post_radiation_ctdna_value - pre_radiation_ctdna_value) / pre_radiation_ctdna_value, NA)
  )

cat("Patients with pre-radiation ctDNA (within 12 weeks): n =", sum(!is.na(conversion_data$pre_radiation_ctdna_value)), "\n")
cat("Patients with post-radiation ctDNA (within 12 weeks): n =", sum(!is.na(conversion_data$post_radiation_ctdna_value)), "\n")
cat("Patients with conversion (detectable to undetectable): n =", sum(conversion_data$converted, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r extract_outcomes, include=FALSE}
# Extract survival outcomes for metastasis-free survival (MFS)
# MFS: time from radiation to next metastatic relapse or death
death_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                       !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
survival_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                     !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
alive_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]
relapse_cols <- names(survival_data)[str_detect(names(survival_data), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date|progression.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

outcomes <- conversion_data %>%
  left_join(
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols, survival_cols, alive_cols))),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    survival_data %>%
      mutate(patient_id = as.character(patient_id)) %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(relapse_cols)),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    # Get next metastatic relapse after radiation
    next_relapse_date = if (length(relapse_cols) > 0) {
      relapse_dates_all <- as_date_safe(dplyr::coalesce(!!!syms(relapse_cols)))
      ifelse(!is.na(relapse_dates_all) & relapse_dates_all > radiation_date, relapse_dates_all, as.Date(NA))
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    alive_status = if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    # MFS: event is next metastatic relapse or death (whichever comes first)
    event_date = pmin(next_relapse_date, death_date, last_fu_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    mfs_event = case_when(
      !is.na(next_relapse_date) & !is.na(event_date) & next_relapse_date == event_date ~ 1,
      !is.na(death_date) & !is.na(event_date) & death_date == event_date ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    mfs_time = as.numeric(event_date - radiation_date)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mfs_time), mfs_time > 0)
```

```{r ctDNA_trajectory_plot}
# Plot ctDNA trajectories around radiation (extended window for visualization)
if (nrow(universe) > 0 && exists("outcomes") && nrow(outcomes) > 0) {
  ctdna_trajectories <- ctdna_long %>%
    inner_join(universe %>% select(patient_id, radiation_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
    filter(
      ctdna_date >= radiation_date - days(84),  # 12 weeks before
      ctdna_date <= radiation_date + days(84)   # 12 weeks after
    ) %>%
    arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
    mutate(
      days_from_radiation = as.numeric(ctdna_date - radiation_date),
      converted = if (exists("outcomes") && nrow(outcomes) > 0) {
        patient_id %in% (outcomes %>% filter(converted == 1) %>% pull(patient_id))
      } else {
        FALSE
      }
    )
} else {
  ctdna_trajectories <- tibble()
}

if (nrow(ctdna_trajectories) > 0) {
  p_trajectory <- ctdna_trajectories %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = days_from_radiation, y = log(ctdna_value + 1), 
               group = patient_id, color = converted)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -84, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 84, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = max(log(ctdna_trajectories$ctdna_value + 1), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
             label = "Radiation", hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5, color = "red", fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = -84, y = max(log(ctdna_trajectories$ctdna_value + 1), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
             label = "-12 weeks", hjust = 1.1, size = 2.5, color = "gray") +
    annotate("text", x = 84, y = max(log(ctdna_trajectories$ctdna_value + 1), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
             label = "+12 weeks", hjust = -0.1, size = 2.5, color = "gray") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#2E86AB", "TRUE" = "#A23B72"),
                       labels = c("FALSE" = "No Conversion", "TRUE" = "Converted"),
                       name = "Conversion") +
    labs(
      x = "Days from Radiation",
      y = "log(ctDNA + 1)",
      title = "ctDNA Trajectories Around Radiation to Metastasis",
      subtitle = "Vertical lines: radiation (red), ±12 weeks window (gray)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray50"))
  
  p_trajectory
  
  # List patient IDs included in the ctDNA trajectory plot
  ctdna_trajectories %>%
    distinct(patient_id) %>%
    arrange(patient_id) %>%
    mutate(`Patient ID` = patient_id) %>%
    select(`Patient ID`) %>%
    kable(caption = "Patient IDs in ctDNA Trajectories Around Radiation") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("No ctDNA trajectory data available for plotting.\n")
}
```

```{r mfs_survival_analysis}
# Metastasis-Free Survival Analysis
# Compare patients by ctDNA conversion status

if (nrow(outcomes) > 0 && sum(!is.na(outcomes$mfs_time)) > 0) {
  # Check if we have both groups
  has_converted <- sum(outcomes$converted == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  has_no_conversion <- sum(outcomes$converted == 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  
  if (has_converted && has_no_conversion) {
    # Create survival object
    surv_obj <- Surv(time = outcomes$mfs_time / 30.44, event = outcomes$mfs_event)  # Convert to months
    
    # Fit survival by conversion status
    fit_by_conversion <- survfit(surv_obj ~ converted, data = outcomes)
    
    # Plot Kaplan-Meier curves
    p_km <- ggsurvplot(
      fit_by_conversion,
      data = outcomes,
      pval = TRUE,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      risk.table = TRUE,
      legend.labs = c("No Conversion", "Converted"),
      title = "Metastasis-Free Survival by ctDNA Conversion Status",
      xlab = "Time (months) from Radiation",
      ylab = "Metastasis-Free Survival Probability",
      palette = c("#2E86AB", "#A23B72"),
      ggtheme = theme_minimal()
    )
    
    print(p_km)
    
    # Cox proportional hazards model
    cox_model <- coxph(surv_obj ~ converted, data = outcomes)
    cox_summary <- summary(cox_model)
    
    # Store cox_summary for use in summary section
    assign("cox_summary", cox_summary, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    
    # Display Cox model results
    cox_results <- tibble(
      `Variable` = "ctDNA Conversion (detectable→undetectable)",
      `HR` = round(exp(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"]), 3),
      `95% CI Lower` = round(exp(cox_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]), 3),
      `95% CI Upper` = round(exp(cox_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]), 3),
      `P-value` = ifelse(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                         "<0.001", 
                         round(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))
    ) %>%
      kable(caption = "Cox Proportional Hazards Model for Metastasis-Free Survival") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
    
    cox_results
  } else {
    cat("Cannot perform survival comparison: need both converted and non-converted groups.\n")
    cat("Converted: n =", sum(outcomes$converted == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("No conversion: n =", sum(outcomes$converted == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  }
  
  # Summary statistics by conversion status
  mfs_summary <- outcomes %>%
    group_by(converted) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Events = sum(mfs_event, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Median MFS (months)` = if (sum(!is.na(mfs_time)) > 0) round(median(mfs_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 30.44, 1) else NA,
      `Mean MFS (months)` = if (sum(!is.na(mfs_time)) > 0) round(mean(mfs_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 30.44, 1) else NA,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(converted == 1, "Converted", "No Conversion")) %>%
    select(Group, N, Events, `Median MFS (months)`, `Mean MFS (months)`) %>%
    kable(caption = "Metastasis-Free Survival by Conversion Status") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  mfs_summary
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for metastasis-free survival analysis.\n")
}
```

```{r summary}
cat("## Summary\n\n")
cat("**Universe:** Patients with radiation to metastasis (target mentions metastasis) AND ctDNA available within 12 weeks before and 12 weeks after radiation\n\n")
cat("**N =", nrow(universe), "\n\n")
if (nrow(outcomes) > 0) {
  cat("**Key Findings:**\n")
  cat("- Patients with pre-radiation ctDNA (within 12 weeks): n =", sum(!is.na(outcomes$pre_radiation_ctdna_value)), "\n")
  cat("- Patients with post-radiation ctDNA (within 12 weeks): n =", sum(!is.na(outcomes$post_radiation_ctdna_value)), "\n")
  cat("- Conversion rate (detectable→undetectable):", round(100 * sum(outcomes$converted, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(outcomes), 1), "%\n")
  if (sum(!is.na(outcomes$pre_radiation_ctdna_value)) > 0) {
    cat("- Median pre-radiation ctDNA:", round(median(outcomes$pre_radiation_ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  }
  if (sum(!is.na(outcomes$post_radiation_ctdna_value)) > 0) {
    cat("- Median post-radiation ctDNA:", round(median(outcomes$post_radiation_ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  }
  if (sum(!is.na(outcomes$mfs_time)) > 0) {
    cat("- Median MFS:", round(median(outcomes$mfs_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 30.44, 1), "months\n")
    cat("- MFS events:", sum(outcomes$mfs_event, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  }
  if (exists("cox_summary")) {
    cat("- HR for conversion (MFS):", round(exp(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"]), 2), 
        " (95% CI: ", round(exp(cox_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]), 2), 
        "-", round(exp(cox_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]), 2), ")\n")
    cat("- P-value:", ifelse(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                              "<0.001", 
                              round(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3)), "\n")
  }
}
```
